text:
The fed funds rate is 5.33%, so the Fed is still on hold at its peak, which puts this in 2023-2024. Unemployment is 3.9%, and the 10-year yield is 4.55%. Core CPI at 3.62% year over year fits roughly March-April 2024, and headline CPI at 3.36% fits May 2024 (CPI was 3.3% in May 2024 and 3.4% in April 2024).

The 3-month change in the 10-year yield is +0.30, and the 12-month change is +0.91. At the end of May 2023 the 10-year was about 3.6%, so a year later it would be about 4.5%. That fits end of May 2024, when the 10-year was about 4.5%. The 2-year at 4.9% is slightly high for end of May (about 4.89%), which also fits.

The 1-month equity return of +5.4% fits May 2024 (S&P up about 5%). Treasuries were up 1.4% in the month, which fits May. Unemployment at 3.9% matches May 2024 (it was 4.0% in May and 3.9% in April), but the data are published with a lag. The 3-month change in unemployment of +0.20 is consistent with that. Gold up 11.6% over 3 months fits too, since it rallied in March-April 2024.

Core CPI of 3.62% matches the April 2024 reading (3.6%), and headline CPI of 3.36% matches April (3.4%). The data therefore describe the end of May 2024, when the latest published CPI was still April's.
